input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation mechanic in the Agreement runs in our favour: in § 6 (p0047) TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," coupled with a one-year price freeze. Nothing in the compensation provisions (§ 5, p0045), the Client covenants and warranties (§ 8) or elsewhere in the document obliges Client to offer TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to other hosts, partners or third parties, or to match any third-party offer. The rule's preferred position is therefore met — Customer bears no MFN obligation benefiting Vendor — and the Vendor-granted MFN is a benefit to us that we do not redline.
